notes.summary: Page 67 is a wholly handwritten prose page about saturated parts and virtual supports. It contains one display, two separately underlined words, several cancellations, a raised e, a raised M0 with a distinct curved insertion arm, and one heavily worked anti suffix. All text has been included; no diagram or marginal sentence is present. Seventeen independent crops were inspected. The started_utc value records the first captured clock time at the start of image inspection; packet reading immediately preceded it.
notes.math_reading_decisions: No proof or mathematical validation was performed. The subject matter prompted scrutiny of the operator’s p count, the sigma/zero distinction, the final M after F0, and the anti suffix. These decisions rest on local ink. In particular, the later display F_sigma subset F does not license changing the earlier F0 de M. No expected order-theoretic property was used to select the anti suffix.
notes.author_checks: The printed fragment ends mid-parenthesis after « partie saturée ». H’s suggestion to read F in « F0 de M » is editorial and unsupported by the two visible M peaks. The first power-set argument M has a crossing horizontal stroke but no readable independent prior symbol. Two low spots below réalisations have no secure linguistic attachment. Crop 16 reaches the lower upright of the second P at its boundary; this framing limitation is recorded and no absence claim is made. The worked anti suffix is reconstructed graphically on one word span rather than decomposed into two supposedly recovered full words.
